justification: Changes the road frontage the granny-flat CDC test uses, which decides PASS or FAIL on the complying development path

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the CDC frontage test uses the bounding rectangle's short side instead of the road-measured width, a malformed or non-finite range is used, or the deployed engine copy drifts
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main route.ts sends frontage_m = calculateLotDimensions().frontage, the shorter side of the minimum-area rectangle. At 6 Berrigan St Winston Hills that is 22.4 m while the edge on the road measures 13.34 m (street-frontage.ts header, measured 2026-10-18), so a 15 m CDC minimum would PASS on a lot whose road frontage is below it. test_road_measured_range_wins_over_single_frontage fails on origin/main (no frontage_range_m parameter).

pre_impl.existing_data: propData.lotGeometry (EPSG:3857) from /api/property; NSW road-corridor layer via detectCornerLot; secondary_dwelling_paths.evaluate_cdc already takes a (min, max) range
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a lot whose geometry is not EPSG:3857, or whose road map query fails three times, gets no frontage and the CDC answer is 'not determined'

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the CDC frontage test uses the rectangle short side, or a malformed range is used
falsifiable_check.observed_red: See top-level observed_red: 22.4 m rectangle side vs 13.34 m road edge at Winston Hills.

functions.name: _frontage_range
functions.input: frontage_range_m from the request, or the older single frontage_m
functions.output: (smallest, largest) width at the building line for the CDC test, or None
functions.if_none: None means the CDC road frontage test answers UNKNOWN, never a pass

functions.name: POST (pathFacts)
functions.input: the lot boundary from the property lookup and the road corridors near it
functions.output: battle_axe and frontage_range_m sent to the detect and confirm engine calls
functions.if_none: no geometry or no measured road edge: frontage_range_m is left out

values.if_missing: falls back to frontage_m, which the route no longer sends; else UNKNOWN

break_it.scenario: a wide shallow lot faces the road on its long side
break_it.what_happens: rectangle short side understated the frontage and failed the CDC test
break_it.how: width is measured back from the road edge

break_it.scenario: caller sends an inverted, zero or infinite range
break_it.what_happens: could pass the CDC test on a nonsense width
break_it.how: _frontage_range returns None; it never repairs the range

break_it.scenario: road map slow on every try
break_it.what_happens: the granny-flat request waits up to 45 s before the engine call
break_it.how: accepted: same three tries as the property panel; then no frontage and the CDC answer is not determined
break_it.repro: block portal.spatial.nsw.gov.au and request a granny-flat report

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — a granny-flat report for 6 Berrigan St Winston Hills shows the CDC frontage as a range near 13 m, not 22.4 m
